sources.title: tiny-aya-earth · Models
sources.snippet: Tiny Aya is a family of massively multilingual small language models built to bring capable AI to languages that are often underserved by existing models. The models support languages across Indic, East and Southeast Asian, African, European, and Middle Eastern language families, with a deliberate emphasis on low-resource language performance.

sources.title: Tiny Aya - OpenModels
sources.snippet: Compact multilingual language model from Cohere For AI with 3.35B parameters, optimized for efficient and balanced multilingual representation across 70+ languages including many lower-resourced ones. Designed for edge deployment without cloud dependency. Trained on 64 NVIDIA H100 GPUs with specialized regional variants available (Global, Earth, Fire).
